hypotheses.mathematical_evidence: AOV fell 14.9%, from €51.07 to €43.45. The largest adverse contributor is AOV, which contributed -0.62 to ROAS (87% of all movement).
hypotheses.unverified_business_cause: A shift in the product mix toward lower‑priced items may have reduced the average order value.
hypotheses.uncertainty: The root cause of the AOV decline remains unknown; further data is required to confirm the product mix hypothesis.

recommendations.investigation: Review the spend distribution across individual campaigns to see if a shift in budget allocation coincides with the AOV drop.
recommendations.what_to_check: Compare campaign‑level spend and average order value for the current and prior week; a significant shift toward campaigns with lower AOV would support the hypothesis.
recommendations.if_supported: Investigate whether the lower‑priced product categories are receiving more spend and consider reallocating budget to higher‑margin campaigns.
recommendations.if_not_supported: If spend distribution is unchanged, examine product catalog for new lower‑priced SKUs or discount changes that could explain the AOV decline.
recommendations.expected_impact: If the hypothesis is correct, adjusting budget or product mix should improve AOV and ROAS.

recommendations.investigation: Analyze order‑level data to identify changes in average items per order or discount rates.
recommendations.what_to_check: Compare the average number of items per order and average discount percentage between the two weeks; a decrease would support the product mix hypothesis.
recommendations.if_supported: Consider promoting higher‑margin or bundle products to increase AOV.
recommendations.if_not_supported: If order composition is unchanged, investigate external factors such as seasonality or competitor pricing that may affect customer purchase behavior.
recommendations.expected_impact: Understanding order composition will clarify whether the AOV drop is due to product mix or other factors.

recommendations.investigation: Obtain industry benchmark data for average order value during this period.
recommendations.what_to_check: Compare the campaign’s AOV to the industry average; a larger decline would suggest external market pressure.
recommendations.if_supported: If the industry also saw a decline, focus on broader market trends rather than internal changes.
recommendations.if_not_supported: If the industry AOV is stable, investigate internal campaign or product changes as the likely cause.
recommendations.expected_impact: Benchmarking will help isolate internal versus external drivers of the AOV change.
